bilingual.notes: MDE does not offer a bilingual education endorsement. Appendix A of the K-12 Educator Licensure Guidelines (Dec 2025) lists Praxis-route foreign-language endorsements (Spanish, French, etc.) but no bilingual-education credential.

eld.notes: 177 — English as a Second Language (K-12) is added to a valid Mississippi license either by passing the Praxis Subject Assessment or by completing an MDE-approved program (Appendix A, K-12 Licensure Guidelines, Dec 2025). No standalone 18-hour coursework path exists for 177. The SEA does not impose a separate practicum on top of the approved-program route; practicum left null pending per-IHE program detail.

sei.notes: Mississippi does not require SEI training of all teachers. Only educators pursuing the 177 ESL endorsement are required to complete EL-specific preparation.

history.title: Mississippi Seal of Biliteracy adopted
history.description: MDE adopted the Mississippi Seal of Biliteracy in 2019, recognizing high school graduates who demonstrate proficiency in English and one or more world languages. The MDE EL services page continues to link to the Seal policy.

history.title: ELP assessment migration: LAS Links → ELPA21 Summative
history.description: Mississippi migrated its annual English Language Proficiency assessment from LAS Links to ELPA21 during the 2024-25 school year. The MDE ELPT page now references ELPA 21 as the contact and ties to the February 2026 Mississippi Testing Accommodations Manual; the MDE EL services page lists "Interpreting ELPA21 Score Reports" as a webinar topic. ELPA21's Spring 2025 Insider newsletter named Mississippi the consortium's "newest partner state" at AMTESOL 2025. This flips `elpAssessment.name` from "LAS Links" to "ELPA21 Summative" and `elpAssessment.consortium` from null to "ELPA21".
